summary: DROP CANDIDATE on price: the stored $50 low is the 'Camper Van/Small Camper Site' capped at 20 ft, which EKKO doesn't fit; the cheapest night EKKO fits is $55 (regular full-hookup sites, 45-60 ft) in January and June 2027, weekday and Saturday. No gateway (Atlanta 164 km); not a Good Sam Park. Google Maps 4.7 from 52 reviews, so a borderline call for AWH. Fees 50-69 -> 55-69; added 50 A, max 60 ft, booking deep link and rules. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price, borderline): cheapest RV night a 23-ft motorhome fits is $55 ('Regular Sites (Closer to the Entrance/Road)', full hookup back-in, 45-55 ft, RoverPass cart $55.00 + RoverPass fees) on Tue 2027-01-26, Sat 2027-01-30, Tue 2027-06-08 and Sat 2027-06-12. Presence passes: operator site live (RoverPass-built), RoverPass listing CLAIMED and bookable (isBookable true, CRS system, operator email and phone).

Long-stay character: 'We welcome long term stays. Call for pricing and availability' and a monthly-reservation deposit rule, but every RV rate sells single nights online with a posted price (test 2 met). 'Recreational campers only.'
Waterfront lead (upward): a 'Creekside Sites' rate ($69, site 12 and others, 30-40 ft) against stored 'not waterfront'. The creek and sites were not measured; the pin is on the RV clearing.
Pin 33.6827,-82.6143 sits on the RV clearing on Esri imagery; Good Sam's point 33.681393,-82.615444 is ~180 m SW by the road. Pin kept.
